content:

摘要：本文考虑了 t-SNE 算法的能量景观。虽然该算法已得到广泛采用，但相关能量的非凸性使得严格理解该算法在许多设置中捕获的内容变得困难。
original_title: On the Abundance of Critical Points of the t-SNE Energy
original_content:
arXiv:2609.04379v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper considers the energy landscape of the t-SNE algorithm. While this algorithm has enjoyed broad adoption, the non-convexity of the associated energy has made it difficult to rigorously understand what the algorithm captures in many settings.
